clauses.title: Dimensions of Plugs and Socket-Outlets
clauses.content: Plugs and sockets rated 6A, 10A, and 16A must conform to the standard gauge dimensions to prevent hazardous or incomplete pin engagement.

clauses.title: Temperature Rise
clauses.content: Temperature rise of terminals shall not exceed 45 K during continuous rated current load testing.
